description: User-generated content — looks like a real person captured it casually. Choose: phone shot, film point-and-shoot, mirror selfie, or car selfie. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: phone_shot = iPhone-style snap. film_pointshoot = Contax T2 grain. mirror_selfie = bathroom/bedroom mirror. car_selfie = inside-the-car phone.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_ugc
title: Apply UGC Style
